findings.title: A lineage formed for reception
findings.claim: The focus descendants can also be perceived as a receiving lineage whose communal form and capacities are made through guidance: the creation sequence moves from progeny to faculties of hearing and sight, while later Book-inheritors show how a formed community may continue to receive.
findings.mechanism: The 32:8–9 traces of generated offspring, extraction, hearing, and sight contact the focus making and lineage carriers; the focus guidance word supplies the direction of reception, and 7:169 independently shows a later generation inheriting the Book. These links let creation and communal reception illuminate each other without treating descent alone as the whole account.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the named lineage as both descended and formed to receive, rather than only as a ready-made audience.
findings.containment: This is a qualified formation analogy, not a claim that 32:8–9 directly describes Israel or proves a historical causal chain. The connection registry rates 32:8 alone as no value for the focus Book/guidance; the added 32:9 faculties and wider Book-inheritance contact keep the reading exploratory at its edge.

epistemic.reason: The HFT anchor sequence and focus returns are explicit, but the formation bridge is reader-attributed and a connection record cautions against using human progeny alone as a direct parallel.

findings.mechanism: Exact 32:11, 32:12, and 32:14 coordinates carry death, return, certainty, and neglect; they contact the focus encounter and doubt branches, while 22:55 and 29:5 independently extend the meeting horizon toward an inescapable hour or appointed arrival. This makes the focus warning resonate with return without erasing its immediate grammar.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold a near-field encounter and an eventual reckoning horizon together, so the warning against doubt has both local and ultimate reach.
findings.containment: The Musa/Book readings remain grammatically live and are not replaced by the Lord-meeting horizon. The root repetitions in 32:13 are only structural echoes here, not independent activators, and the HFT source remains legacy_unbound.

epistemic.reason: The detailed HFT trace gives exact context coordinates and focus returns, and the wider connection passages support the meeting horizon; the source identity remains legacy_unbound and alternatives stay unresolved.

findings.mechanism: The exact 32:15–16 response sequence independently contacts the focus course-and-manner and composed-bearing facets of هدى. Remembering, falling, prostration, praise, refusal of pride, leaving the bed, and calling make guidance perceptible as a changed bodily course in addition to understood content.
findings.reader_payoff: Guidance becomes observable in posture, movement, voice, and settled conduct, not only as a proposition carried by the Book.
findings.containment: These bodily acts are effects and an analogy for the focus guidance, not a replacement for its verbal/propositional sense. The HFT source is legacy_unbound, and a connection row rates 32:16 as no direct clarification of the focus.

epistemic.reason: The response sequence and focus-word branches have exact packet coordinates, while source trust is legacy_unbound and the registry contains a no-value connection counterreading.

friction_notes: The packet's focus-word alignment resolves all 19/19 analysis units with no unresolved joins; no reading was excluded because of a missing alignment.
The pronoun in مِن لِّقَآئِهِۦ remains open among the local Musa/Book readings and the wider meeting-with-the-Lord horizon; no finding ranks those alternatives.
The final pronoun in وَجَعَلْنَٰهُ can remain open among the Book, Musa, and guidance carried through descendants; the lineage finding preserves these possibilities rather than disambiguating.
Cross-surah connection records supply exact target Arabic but generally no target morphology; no external lexical analysis is inferred from those rows.
For legacy_unbound HFT traces whose branch records are unresolved, exact anchor ayat and word indices are retained as attributed evidence with null gloss/facet; no branch meaning is invented.

The 32:5 governance circuit, 32:8–9 receiving-lineage model, 32:15–16 embodied reading, and 32:3/26 warning or gait images are bounded contextual analogies; the supplied no-value connection rows remain visible as counter-readings where relevant.

The 32:2 Book-root repetition and 32:3 giving/guidance-root repetitions in the provenance trace are structural echoes only; they are not treated as independent context inventories or added branch activations.

The repeated focus being-root at 32:5 and making-root at 32:8–9 are structural cues, not separate lexical activations; the governance and receiving-lineage readings rely on the named context events as distinct triggers.

The repeated focus meeting-root cues at 32:10/14 and the 32:13 gift/guidance repetitions in the meeting trace are structural echoes only; they do not disambiguate the pronoun or serve as independent branch evidence.
